تقترعوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِعُوا (taqtariʕū) /taq.ta.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# تُقْتَرَعُوا (tuqtaraʕū) /tuq.ta.ra.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
